summary: explicit choice for scope dual: the cores run independent jobs and exchange no data (e.g. CM33 = BLE, CM55 = UI/sensors as in E84_TouchUI)
source: core split of E84_TouchUI (https://github.com/NnopponS/WheelSense_Project/tree/prototype/tesaIoT-hackathon/firmware/E84_TouchUI): CM33_NS BLE task, CM55 everything else, no IPC
notes: no files; peripherals still have one owner core (claims); a later data exchange needs a real IPC template
